overview.title: Harbor City FFL at a glance
overview.description: How the league is organized, what defines the current season, and where to find its records.

paragraphs: 2026 is the active Harbor City season, played on Sleeper as a 12-team auction keeper league.
Harbor City has continuous league history since 2011. Game-by-game records begin with the 2022 Sleeper season.
Every completed season from 2011 through 2025 is archived, with champions and franchise history kept.

story.title: Our Story: Harbor City
story.teaser: Harbor City FFL was born in 2011 at a dockside bar, when ten friends decided an auction draft was the only fair way to settle who knew football best.
